title: poa spinosa
intro: Poa spinosa, commonly known as the prickly meadow-grass, is a species of grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Poa spinosa include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it a useful remedy for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Poa spinosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
